items.title: Ernest Poree Interview, 1975-10-16
items.q: They were pretty good to work with. And we worked together quite a long while.

ctx.x: No, you hear it with the bell. The edge of the bell.

And this guy, you say, the boss, he comes to and says, what happened Billy? Oh, when I was coming to work, I fell off the streetcar. He said, no, you're lying. I said, because I was looking at you when you were coming here. There wasn't nothing wrong with you with me. I was being brought with me, gushing out of him. So he said, suppose they could suspend him for two weeks. Give him two weeks suspension. We went with our golf. Told the waiters to come back there. Tell us don't come back no more. We all lost the…
